relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Erenumab is a calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)-receptor antibody inhibiting CGRP function.

relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Seventy-three patients (80.2%) responded to erenumab treatment, defined as ≥50% reduction of migraine days per month, across all migraine types.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP was described as a crucial mediator in the process of a migraine attack with potential therapeutic implications.

key_findings: 80.2% of 91 migraine patients responded (>=50% reduction in monthly migraine days) to erenumab; medication overuse headache responded less.
Older age and non-Middle Eastern ethnicity associated with better response.
